graph_discipline: Roots remain nodes; branches are edge or port labels, not graph nodes.

root_resolution.note: The basmala is part of the analysis frame and reinforces mercy, divine benefaction, lordship, protection, and sought approval without adding roots to the supplied inventory. Four Furūq-only branches remain valid lexical branches.

surface_mechanism: 92:17 promises that the most God-conscious person will be kept away from the fire, joining causative avoidance to protective piety.
92:18 defines that person by giving his wealth in order to purify himself, binding generosity, property, growth, almsgiving, and moral purification.
92:19 excludes repayment of any prior human favor as the motive, placing recompense and benefaction under exhaustive negation.
92:20 supplies the exclusive motive: seeking the Face of his Lord, the Most High; face, intention, lordship, and elevation form one devotional orientation.
92:21 emphatically promises future satisfaction, completing the movement from self-purifying gift to divine reward and contentment.
